autumn.question: Autumn has 32 pencils and 10 erasers. She puts all of them into identical gift bags, with the same number of pencils in each bag and the same number of erasers in each bag. What is the greatest number of bags she can make with nothing left over? Enter the number of bags.

follow_up_questions.question: Autumn splits 32 pencils and 10 erasers equally among 2 identical gift bags, with nothing left over. How many pencils are in each bag? Enter a whole number.
